scenarios.name: Description without property ID (Holdout)
scenarios.description: Customer asks for a 2-bedroom place with a patio without specifying property ID or address.

conversation.content: I'm looking for a 2-bedroom place with a patio. Do you have anything like that?

scenarios.name: Vague property description
scenarios.description: Customer describes a modern house with a nice garden vaguely without specifying address or ID.

conversation.content: Can you tell me more about that modern house you have listed with a nice garden?

scenarios.name: Multiple possible properties downtown
scenarios.description: Customer asks broadly about apartments downtown without identifying a listing.

conversation.content: I'm interested in viewing one of your apartments downtown. Which ones are open?

scenarios.name: Premature viewing request missing property
scenarios.description: Customer tries to book a viewing slot without naming any property or ID.

conversation.content: Can I schedule a viewing for this Saturday September 20th at 2pm please?

scenarios.name: Broad budget and features inquiry
scenarios.description: Customer provides broad criteria without referencing a specific listing.

conversation.content: Do you have any 3-bedroom family properties under $500k in a quiet neighborhood?

scenarios.name: Ambiguous referral / partial street name
scenarios.description: Customer mentions a friend's recommendation on Maple Drive without unit or listing ID.

conversation.content: A friend told me about a nice place for sale on Maple Drive. What are the details on it?
